duplicate_or_alternate_copy.title: Computer Organization and Design
duplicate_or_alternate_copy.finding: The extra file remains unregistered because another fifth-edition copy is already registered and cited by 14 notes; it is not a unique content gap.

conclusion: Every unique book identified as unnoted by the post-DA audit now has a governed private source record and a six-note detailed pack.
limitations: This conclusion covers the curated 35-PDF acquisition collection, not every file in the supplemental inventory.
Registry coverage and written notes do not prove reader mastery or sentence-level fidelity without owner review.
